title: Pressure–Volume Loop
description: Change preload, afterload, contractility and heart rate, and watch a live left-ventricle model redraw its PV loop and Wiggers diagram beat by beat.

title: The Nephron and Diuretics
description: Follow salt and water along a nephron, segment by segment, and see where each diuretic blocks salt reabsorption and how much water follows it out.

title: Frank–Starling and Cardiac Output
description: Why a fuller heart pumps harder, and how filling, heart rate and contraction strength add up to cardiac output.
